system.description: Your Shin-Seals can now be stacked and layered onto creatures forming a more oppressive mark. A creature can now have up to 5 Shin-Seals on them at any given time. When a creature with Shin-Seals on them casts a Jutsu that you can see, you can spend your reaction to dispel all Shin-Seals on them. For every Shin-Seal dispelled this way, they increase the cost of the jutsu cast by +6.
